headline: Corgi Loaf Baking Co.: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is projected #4 of 16 with a 673.80 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Tyler Warren, and Malik Nabers. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core.
